# Skill 3 — CLV Broker & Company

A Claude Code **skill**. Computes Customer Lifetime Value for every broker and company in the Pramukh Gems customer base. Claude runs the CLV calculator and returns a ranked table of lifetime values with profit, churn, and tier signals.

## Layout

```
skills/clv-broker-company/
├── SKILL.md                      # skill — frontmatter + instructions Claude reads
├── scripts/
│   └── clv_broker_company.py     # CLV engine + CLI
├── install.sh                    # copies skill into .claude/skills/ to activate
└── README.qmd                    # this file
```

## Activate it

```bash
bash skills/clv-broker-company/install.sh
```

Restart Claude Code (or open a new session) to activate.

## Using it through Claude

> "What's the CLV of broker CUST0013?"
> "Rank all brokers by lifetime value."
> "Show me the CLV breakdown for company CUST0082."
> "Who are our top 10 customers by CLV?"

## Running the script directly

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate

# All brokers ranked by CLV
uv run python skills/clv-broker-company/scripts/clv_broker_company.py --brokers

# All companies ranked by CLV
uv run python skills/clv-broker-company/scripts/clv_broker_company.py --companies

# Single broker + breakdown of their companies
uv run python skills/clv-broker-company/scripts/clv_broker_company.py --broker CUST0013

# JSON output
uv run python skills/clv-broker-company/scripts/clv_broker_company.py --brokers --json

# With LLM narrative
uv run python skills/clv-broker-company/scripts/clv_broker_company.py --brokers --model api-llama-4-scout
```

## CLV model

Uses the standard discounted CLV formula from `skills/example/scripts/clv_skill.py`:

```
CLV = (avg_monthly_profit / monthly_churn_rate) × [1 − 1/(1+discount_rate)^T]
```

Inputs derived from seed data:
- **avg_monthly_profit** = total gross profit from sales / months active
- **churn_rate** = `churn_risk_pct` from customers table
- **discount_rate** = 0.8% / month (≈ 10% annual)
- **time_horizon** = 36 months

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_clv_broker_company.py -v
```

25 tests covering `clv_inputs_for_entity`, `compute_entity_clv`, `broker_breakdown`, `compute_all_clv`, and CLI.
